question: An infinite line charge with uniform linear density $+λ$ is placed along the z-axis. An external uniform electric field $\vec{E}_0 = E_0\hat{j}$ is also present in the region. A small electric dipole of moment $\vec{p}$ is placed on the x-axis at a distance '$a$' from the origin (at point $(a, 0, 0)$). For the dipole to be in stable equilibrium, what must be the angle $θ$ that its moment vector $\vec{p}$ makes with the positive x-axis?
